cmd: show dnos-internal routing evpn mac-mobility-redis-count | no-more
purpose: Cluster-wide counted-move gauge. 0 for null-ESI moves; increments (e.g. 0->2 for MAC+IP) on a distinct-ESI counted move. Sample before AND after each suspected move.

cmd: show evpn instance EVPN_CLTEST_IRB mac-table suppress | no-more
purpose: Mobility suppression table. Empty unless the move rate crosses the mac-move threshold. Empty during a single counted move.
Confirms the per-AC ESI actually formed an Ethernet Segment (State Up, Attached to service). Renders ESI as 10 octets (config value is 9).
